improv_extras.concept: fold the point cloud through an iterated-function-system (affine contractions + rotation) so a self-similar fractal structure emerges

v1.feedback: The IFS Barnsley fern is technically clean and immediately readable — leaf-shaped fragment discs, moss-to-bone palette, and gentle breathing sway all land well. However, chain mode requires a continuous morph from parent hg5 (shape_glyph mutation), and this reads as a fresh standalone fern with no structural DNA from the parent; add an interpolation path or hybrid geometry that visibly carries hg5's glyph-form into the fern silhouette. The reveal animation (particles falling from sky) is pleasant but could be replaced with a morph-from-parent transition to satisfy the chain contract.
